raise_AbsentAgentError: raise AbsentAgentError with a message and agent_id when an agent leaves a task
raise_AgentDisconnectedError: raise AgentDisconnectedError with an agent_id when a real disconnect event occurs with no signal
raise_AgentTimeoutError: raise AgentTimeoutError with a timeout value and agent_id when a worker does not respond in time
raise_AgentReturnedError: raise AgentReturnedError with an agent_id when a worker explicitly returns a task
raise_AgentShutdownError: raise AgentShutdownError with an agent_id when a task is shutdown but agents are still active
